combine:
usage: sed-tools combine [-h] [--base BASE] [--output OUTPUT] [--non-interactive]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --base BASE        Base spectral grid directory
  --output OUTPUT    Name for the combined spectral grid
  --non-interactive  Combine all spectral grids without prompting
config:
usage: sed-tools config [-h] [--set PATH] [--move]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --set PATH  Set data directory to PATH
  --move      With --set: move existing data to the new path
coverage:
usage: sed-tools coverage [-h] [--base BASE] [--grids [MODELS ...]] [--no-plot] [--out OUT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           Base spectral grid dir
  --grids, --models [MODELS ...]
                        Spectral grid folder name(s); prompted if omitted
  --no-plot             Skip the coverage plot
  --out OUT             Output path for the plot PNG (single spectral grid only)
densify:
usage: sed-tools densify [-h] --flux-cube FLUX_CUBE --output OUTPUT [--teff-spacing TEFF_SPACING]
                         [--method {auto,interp,ml,blackbody}] [--ml-model ML_MODEL]
                         [--ml-gap-threshold ML_GAP_THRESHOLD] [--no-lookup]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --flux-cube FLUX_CUBE
  --output OUTPUT
  --teff-spacing TEFF_SPACING
  --method {auto,interp,ml,blackbody}
  --ml-model ML_MODEL
  --ml-gap-threshold ML_GAP_THRESHOLD
  --no-lookup
filters:
usage: sed-tools filters [-h] [--base BASE] [--components COMPONENTS] [--bands BANDS [BANDS ...]]
                         [--detector-type {energy,photon}] [--airmass AIRMASS] [--pwv PWV]
                         [--atmosphere-site ATMOSPHERE_SITE] [--allow-heavy] [--allow-partial]
                         [target]

positional arguments:
  target                Facility/Instrument; omit to browse

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           Base filter directory
  --components COMPONENTS
                        Roles separated by commas or '+': filter, optics, qe, published
  --bands BANDS [BANDS ...]
                        Compose only these bands
  --detector-type {energy,photon}
                        Override integration weighting in a derived copy; preserves published
                        curves
  --airmass AIRMASS     Add the instrument's own-site atmosphere at this airmass ('unstated' for a
                        team atmosphere whose source gives none)
  --pwv PWV             Atmospheric precipitable water vapour (mm)
  --atmosphere-site ATMOSPHERE_SITE
                        One of the instrument's own atmosphere sites (default: its default site)
  --allow-heavy         Permit large original-source downloads
  --allow-partial       Use zero outside component wavelength coverage
filters-build-components:
usage: sed-tools filters-build-components [-h] [--base BASE] [--raw RAW] [--instrument INSTRUMENT]
                                          [--sites SITES [SITES ...]] [--archive ARCHIVE]
                                          [--airmass AIRMASS [AIRMASS ...]] [--pwv PWV [PWV ...]]
                                          source

positional arguments:
  source                Component source (lsst, hst, jwst, hsc, decam, vista, ztf, tabular,
                        skycalc, team_atmospheres, argus) or 'all'

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           Base filter directory
  --raw RAW             Raw input directory (source specific)
  --instrument INSTRUMENT
                        Instrument for a shared tabular source (HAWKI, NACO, SPHERE, GSAOI or
                        NIFS)
  --sites SITES [SITES ...]
                        SkyCalc or team atmosphere sites
  --archive ARCHIVE     Keep every raw download here with its URL, time and SHA-256 (skycalc,
                        team_atmospheres)
  --airmass AIRMASS [AIRMASS ...]
                        SkyCalc airmass grid
  --pwv PWV [PWV ...]   SkyCalc PWV grid (mm)
filters-cite:
usage: sed-tools filters-cite [-h] [--format {text,bibtex,json}] [--base BASE] [--refresh]
                              [--offline]
                              [targets ...]

positional arguments:
  targets               Facility/Instrument or Facility/Instrument/Band; default: every installed
                        instrument

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,bibtex,json}
  --base BASE           Base filter directory
  --refresh             Use NJM's current info.json, not installed copies
  --offline             Use installed and cached info.json only
filters-combine:
usage: sed-tools filters-combine [-h] [--base BASE] [--facility FACILITY]
                                 [--instrument INSTRUMENT]
                                 [--on-conflict {rename,overwrite,error}]
                                 output inputs [inputs ...]

positional arguments:
  output                Output name or Facility/Instrument path for the combined filter set
  inputs                Filter-set directories or .dat files to combine

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           Base filter directory
  --facility FACILITY   Output facility label (default: Combined)
  --instrument INSTRUMENT
                        Output instrument/index-file name
  --on-conflict {rename,overwrite,error}
                        How duplicate filter filenames are handled
filters-compose:
usage: sed-tools filters-compose [-h] [--base BASE] [--components COMPONENTS]
                                 [--bands BANDS [BANDS ...]] [--detector-type {energy,photon}]
                                 [--airmass AIRMASS] [--pwv PWV]
                                 [--atmosphere-site ATMOSPHERE_SITE] [--allow-heavy]
                                 [--allow-partial]
                                 target

positional arguments:
  target                Facility/Instrument or installed instrument directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           Base filter directory
  --components COMPONENTS
                        Roles separated by commas or '+': filter, optics, qe, published
  --bands BANDS [BANDS ...]
                        Compose only these bands
  --detector-type {energy,photon}
                        Override integration weighting in a derived copy; preserves published
                        curves
  --airmass AIRMASS     Add the instrument's own-site atmosphere at this airmass ('unstated' for a
                        team atmosphere whose source gives none)
  --pwv PWV             Atmospheric precipitable water vapour (mm)
  --atmosphere-site ATMOSPHERE_SITE
                        One of the instrument's own atmosphere sites (default: its default site)
  --allow-heavy         Permit large original-source downloads
  --allow-partial       Use zero outside component wavelength coverage
filters-detector:
usage: sed-tools filters-detector [-h] [--facility FACILITY] [--force] [--dry-run] [path]

positional arguments:
  path                 Filter root, instrument directory or single .dat file

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --facility FACILITY  SVO facility name when PATH is a single instrument directory or file
  --force              Re-resolve files that are already tagged; a result never replaces a type
                       from a stronger source (original > inferred > svo > svo-curve-match >
                       assumed)
  --dry-run            Report without modifying files
filters-info:
usage: sed-tools filters-info [-h] [--base BASE] [--offline] [--json] target

positional arguments:
  target       Facility/Instrument, e.g. SLOAN/SDSS

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --base BASE  Base filter directory
  --offline    Inspect local data without contacting sources
  --json       Emit availability as JSON
filters-inventory:
usage: sed-tools filters-inventory [-h] [--base BASE] [--facility FACILITY] [--offline] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --base BASE          Base filter directory
  --facility FACILITY  Limit discovery to this facility
  --offline            List local and registered instruments only
  --json               Emit inventory and source errors as JSON
filters-search:
usage: sed-tools filters-search [-h] [--facility FACILITY] [--instrument INSTRUMENT] [--band BAND]
                                [--wavelength Å [Å ...]] [--pivot LOW HIGH] [--fwhm LOW HIGH]
                                [--detector-type {energy,photon}] [--where KEY=VALUE|KEY=LOW:HIGH]
                                [--columns COLUMNS] [--names-only] [--format {table,csv,json}]
                                [--base BASE] [--refresh] [--offline]
                                [text]

positional arguments:
  text                  Case-insensitive substring of Facility/Instrument/Band

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --facility FACILITY   Facility name contains this
  --instrument INSTRUMENT
                        Instrument name contains this
  --band BAND           Band name contains this
  --wavelength Å [Å ...]
                        One value: bands covering it; two: bands overlapping that range
  --pivot LOW HIGH      Pivot wavelength range in Å ('-' leaves an end open)
  --fwhm LOW HIGH       FWHM range in Å
  --detector-type {energy,photon}
  --where KEY=VALUE|KEY=LOW:HIGH
                        Any properties.json column, e.g. ABminusVega=:0.5 or ColorMethod=true;
                        repeatable
  --columns COLUMNS     Comma-separated columns to show (default: facility,instrument,band,Wavelen
                        gthPivot,FWHM,WavelengthMin,WavelengthMax,DetectorType)
  --names-only          Match names in index.json only; fetch no properties
  --format {table,csv,json}
  --base BASE           Base filter directory (cache beside it)
  --refresh             Ask NJM again instead of using the cache
  --offline             Use the cached catalogue only
grids:
usage: sed-tools grids [-h] [--source {njm,svo,msg,mast,both,all}] [--grids [MODELS ...]]
                       [--base BASE] [--workers WORKERS] [--no-h5] [--no-cube]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source {njm,svo,msg,mast,both,all}
                        Which provider(s) to use. NJM mirror is checked first when available.
  --grids, --models [MODELS ...]
                        Spectral grid names to process, or 'all'
  --base BASE           Output directory for spectral grids
  --workers WORKERS     Parallel workers
  --no-h5               Do not force-create HDF5 bundle
  --no-cube             Skip flux cube build
import:
usage: sed-tools import [-h] --path PATH [--name NAME] [--base BASE] [--move] [--no-h5]
                        [--no-cube] [--dry-run]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --path PATH  Directory of .txt spectra (or a single .txt file)
  --name NAME  Spectral grid name (default: source folder name)
  --base BASE  Base spectral grid dir
  --move       Move files instead of copying
  --no-h5      Skip HDF5 bundle
  --no-cube    Skip flux cube
  --dry-run    Report parseable headers without importing
mesa_prepare:
usage: sed-tools mesa_prepare [-h] [--base BASE] [--grid MODEL] [--output OUTPUT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           Base spectral grid directory
  --grid, --model MODEL
                        Spectral grid name (e.g. Kurucz2003all); prompted if omitted
  --output OUTPUT       Output directory for the exported variant; prompted if omitted
ml_completer:
usage: sed-tools ml_completer [-h] [--base BASE] [--models-dir MODELS_DIR]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           Base spectral grid directory
  --models-dir MODELS_DIR
                        Directory for trained ML models
ml_generator:
usage: sed-tools ml_generator [-h] [--base BASE] [--models-dir MODELS_DIR] [--auto]
                              [--library LIBRARY] [--output OUTPUT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           Base spectral grid directory
  --models-dir MODELS_DIR
                        Directory for trained ML models
  --auto                Run optimized auto-training with hyperparameter search
  --library LIBRARY     Library path for auto-training
  --output OUTPUT       Output directory for auto-training
rebuild:
usage: sed-tools rebuild [-h] [--base BASE] [--grids [MODELS ...]] [--no-h5] [--no-cube]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           Base spectral grid dir
  --grids, --models [MODELS ...]
                        Names of local spectral grids to rebuild
  --no-h5               Skip HDF5 bundle
  --no-cube             Skip flux cube
sed-tools:
usage: sed-tools [-h]
                 {grids,spectra,filters,filters-combine,filters-detector,filters-info,filters-search,filters-cite,filters-compose,filters-inventory,filters-build-components,rebuild,combine,ml_completer,ml_generator,densify,mesa_prepare,config,coverage,import} ...

SED Tools — spectral grids and photometric filters

positional arguments:
  {grids,spectra,filters,filters-combine,filters-detector,filters-info,filters-search,filters-cite,filters-compose,filters-inventory,filters-build-components,rebuild,combine,ml_completer,ml_generator,densify,mesa_prepare,config,coverage,import}
    grids (spectra)     Download and build spectral grids
    filters             Download instrument passbands or browse interactively
    filters-combine     Combine filter sets into one MESA-compatible instrument
    filters-detector    Tag filter files as photon- or energy-counting (DetectorType header)
    filters-info        Show what a filter set contains and which components can be requested
    filters-search      Search NJM's filter catalogue by name, wavelength and properties (no SVO)
    filters-cite        Print references (BibTeX), acknowledgements and licences for instruments
    filters-compose     Compose optical-path components
    filters-inventory   Inventory all SVO, NJM, local and registered instruments
    filters-build-components
                        (Mirror curation) populate components/atmospheres from a published source
    rebuild             Rebuild lookup table + HDF5 + flux cube
    combine             Combine multiple grids into omni grid
    ml_completer        Train/use ML SED completer
    ml_generator        Train/use ML SED generator
    densify             Fill coarse Teff gaps in a flux_cube.bin
    mesa_prepare        Export a spectral grid variant as a clean MESA-ready folder
    config              Show or set the data directory
    coverage            Report parameter-space coverage of a local grid
    import              Ingest a local grid of .txt spectra into the pipeline

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
